title: Lotofácil 3788: Main Prize Rolls Over to R$9 Million
seoTitle: Lotofácil 3788: R$9 Million Main Prize Rolls Over
subtitle: No wager matched all 15 numbers in last Thursday's draw, increasing anticipation for the next round.
excerpt: Lotofácil's 3788 draw saw no top-tier winners for 15 numbers, leading the prize to roll over to R$9 million for the upcoming draw.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Bettors' attention turns to Lotofácil after draw 3788, held last Thursday (24), registered no winners in the main 15-number tier. Consequently, the main prize rolled over, and Caixa Econômica Federal estimates a value of R$9 million for the next draw, which will take place this Friday (25).

What Happened in Draw 3788

The Lotofácil 3788 draw was held at Espaço da Sorte, in São Paulo, and featured the following numbers: 01, 04, 05, 07, 08, 09, 12, 16, 17, 18, 20, 21, 22, 23, and 24. Although no wager matched all 15 numbers, the draw awarded prizes to over 821,000 bets in other tiers.

Check out the prize details for draw 3788:

  • 14 hits: 197 winning bets, each receiving R$2,929.06;
  • 13 hits: 8,721 winning bets, each receiving R$35;
  • 12 hits: 118,763 winning bets, each receiving R$14;
  • 11 hits: 693,509 winning bets, each receiving R$7.

The total collection for draw 3788 reached R$30,060,317.

Understanding the R$9 Million Estimate

For the next draw, 3789, Caixa Econômica Federal projects a prize of R$9 million. This estimate includes the expected collection from new wagers until sales close. The amount effectively rolled over after last Thursday's draw was R$4,087,321.38.

Furthermore, Lotofácil already has R$2,399,681.58 accumulated for draw 3790 and R$3,599,522.52 reserved for the upcoming Independence Special Draw.

How Lotofácil Works

In Lotofácil, players choose 15 to 20 numbers from the 25 available on the ticket. The chance of winning and the bet value vary according to the number of marked digits. Prize tiers include those who match 11, 12, 13, 14, or 15 numbers.

There are different betting modes, such as Surpresinha, where the system automatically chooses the numbers. There is also Teimosinha, which allows the bettor to compete with the same combination for 3, 6, 12, 18, or 24 consecutive draws. It is also possible to participate in syndicates.

Lotofácil draws take place six times a week, from Monday to Friday, at 9 PM, and on Sundays, at 11 AM. To participate, one must be over 18 years old. Bets can be placed at lottery agencies, on the Loterias Online portal, or via the Loterias Caixa app, available for iOS and Android 24 hours a day.

Prize Redemption and Important Tips

Caixa Lotteries prizes can be redeemed up to 90 calendar days after the draw date. For physical bets, the original ticket must be preserved, and it is recommended to identify the back with your full name and CPF (Brazilian individual taxpayer ID). In the case of syndicates, each participant receives the share corresponding to their quota.

Prize amounts can be withdrawn at Caixa Econômica Federal branches. Prizes exempt from Income Tax can also be redeemed at lottery agencies or via Mercado Pago, with the possibility of transfer to the bettor's bank account, provided the CPF matches the registration. It is essential that only the CPF holder used in the bet's registration, or a legally recognized proxy, collects the prizes.

With information from G1, Estadão, ISTOÉ DINHEIRO.
